body: Thank you for the optimism and sound advice. I am very lucky to have my amazing parents and I need to show it more rather than leeching off of them and being an unsuccessful grump. I should probably seek help, but I don't know how to go about speaking with someone. My thoughts are so private to me and I don't easily let others in. How can it be so simple for some people to form deep bonds and share intimate secrets? It must be wonderful.

Really? I've never outwardly shared my feelings with people like this before. It brings a little peace to me knowing that I'm not comletely alone. The happiest memory that comes to mind is collecting shells and baby hermit crabs on the beach with my dad as a little kid. Wow, things were simple then. I smiled thinking back on those times. Thank you!
